text: According to Sea Limited's FY2025 annual report, Free Fire was made unavailable in the Google Play Store and iOS App Store in India in early 2022 due to unanticipated government actions, and as of the FY2025 filing, it currently remains unavailable in India [Sea, FY2025, p.10].

answer: According to Sea Limited's FY2025 annual report, Free Fire was made unavailable in the Google Play Store and iOS App Store in India in early 2022 due to unanticipated government actions, and as of the FY2025 filing, it currently remains unavailable in India [Sea, FY2025, p.10].
